info.title: Multicast_Operational_Static_Route
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address_family.description: The IP version of this summarized multicast route entry.

configured.description: Multicast Operational Static Route table can have entries learnt from the unknown multicast packets received on a multicast enabled interface. This flag indicates if this entry is added by a static multicast route configuration or not. Default value is `true`.

creation_time.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when this multicast route entry was instantiated in the system.

group_address.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Route](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Route)
The Group Address of the stream.

l3_vni.description:
Reference Resource: [Virtual_Network_ID](#/Virtual_Network_ID)
Upstream L3 Virtual Network Identifier on which the source stream is received.

mcast_nexthops.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop)
The outgoing list of [Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop] (Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop)s associated with this route entry.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Route](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Route)
The upstream [Port](#/Port) on which the source stream is received.

source_address.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Route](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Route)
The Source Address of the stream. This includes wildcard entry 'any' for (*, G) entries.

upstream_source_list.description: The list of upstream sources that are part of the summarized multicast route. The source_address in this case will be set to 'any'. For non-summarized entries, the source_address specifies the upstream source and upstream_source_list will be empty.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
